definitions.explanation: A reference book that systematically explains the grammar rules of a language. Used by learners and specialists alike.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}の{文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an English grammar book.

examples.japanese: わからない{時|とき}は{文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}で{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: When I don't understand something, I look it up in a grammar book.

examples.japanese: この{文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}は{例文|れいぶん}が{多|おお}くて{初心者|しょしんしゃ}にも{分|わ}かりやすい。
examples.english: This grammar book has many example sentences and is easy even for beginners.

notes:
Compound of {文法|ぶんぽう} (grammar) + {書|しょ} (book, writing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}で{調|しら}べる: to look something up in a grammar book
- {文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}を{開|ひら}く: to open a grammar book

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {参考書|さんこうしょ}: study reference book — broader, covers any subject
- {辞書|じしょ}: dictionary — for words and meanings, not grammar rules
